articles.title: The quiet value of deep work
articles.subtitle: 深度专注，那些安静生长的价值

sentences.en: In a world that rewards immediate responses, the ability to concentrate has become an increasingly valuable resource.
sentences.zh: 在一个推崇即时回应的世界里，集中注意力的能力已成为一种日益宝贵的资源。
sentences.note: that rewards immediate responses 是修饰 world 的定语从句；has become 强调变化延续至今。immediate responses 在此指迅速回复消息或作出反应。

sentences.en: Students are often encouraged to collect more information, yet the quality of their understanding depends on what they do with it.
sentences.zh: 人们常常鼓励学生获取更多信息，然而，他们理解的深度取决于如何处理这些信息。
sentences.note: yet 连接两个有转折关系的分句。what they do with it 是介词 on 的宾语从句，it 指前文的 information。quality 在此结合语境译为理解的深度。

sentences.en: Reading an argument carefully, questioning its assumptions and relating it to previous knowledge all require sustained attention.
sentences.zh: 仔细阅读一套论证、质疑其前提假设，并将其与已有知识建立联系，这些都需要持续的专注。
sentences.note: 三个动名词短语并列作主语，谓语用 require。relate A to B 表示将 A 与 B 联系起来；sustained attention 指持续保持的注意力。

sentences.en: These activities are difficult to accomplish when every notification creates an opportunity to switch tasks.
sentences.zh: 如果每一条通知都在诱使人切换任务，上述学习活动就很难完成。
sentences.note: These activities 承接上句的三项活动。an opportunity to switch tasks 字面为切换任务的机会；此处按干扰专注的语境译为诱使人切换任务。

sentences.en: The cost of an interruption extends beyond the few seconds spent checking a message.
sentences.zh: 中断带来的代价，并不止于查看一条消息所花的那几秒钟。
sentences.note: extend beyond 表示超出。spent checking a message 是过去分词短语，修饰 seconds；可还原为 seconds that are spent checking a message。

sentences.en: Before returning to the original problem, a reader must reconstruct the context that made the ideas meaningful.
sentences.zh: 重新回到原来的问题之前，读者必须重建先前的语境，才能再次理解那些观点的意义。
sentences.note: Before returning 的逻辑主语是 a reader。that made the ideas meaningful 修饰 context；make + 宾语 + 形容词构成宾语补足结构。

sentences.en: A short distraction can therefore produce a substantial delay in genuine understanding.
sentences.zh: 因此，一次短暂的分心，就可能显著延缓真正理解的过程。
sentences.note: therefore 表示因果推论。substantial 在这里表示相当大的、显著的；genuine understanding 强调真正理解，而非表面记住。

sentences.en: What appears to be efficient multitasking may simply be a series of unfinished attempts.
sentences.zh: 看似高效的多任务处理，实际上可能只是一连串未完成的尝试。
sentences.note: What appears to be efficient multitasking 是主语从句。appears to be 与 may simply be 形成表象与实际的对照；may 保留判断的不确定性。

sentences.en: Protecting attention does not require abandoning technology or working without a break.
sentences.zh: 保护注意力，并不意味着必须抛弃技术，也不意味着要不间断地工作。
sentences.note: require 后接两个并列的动名词短语：abandoning technology 和 working without a break。根据语境将 does not require 译为并不意味着必须。

sentences.en: It requires making deliberate choices about when to be available and when to remain undisturbed.
sentences.zh: 它要求我们有意识地作出选择：什么时候接受联系，什么时候保持不受打扰。
sentences.note: It 指 protecting attention。两个 when + 不定式结构并列，作 about 的宾语。available 在此不是有空闲，而是可以被联系。

sentences.en: For example, a student can reserve twenty minutes for one passage and write a brief summary before opening another application.
sentences.zh: 例如，学生可以留出二十分钟专读一篇文章，并在打开另一个应用程序之前，先写下一段简短的总结。
sentences.note: reserve ... for ... 表示为某事预留时间。两个动作 reserve 和 write 并列；before opening 限定总结应先于切换应用完成。

sentences.en: The summary reveals whether the main argument has been understood or merely recognized.
sentences.zh: 这段总结能够揭示：学生究竟理解了文章的主要论点，还是仅仅觉得它似曾相识。
sentences.note: whether ... or ... 引导选择关系的宾语从句。has been understood 是现在完成时的被动语态；recognized 与 understood 共用 has been。

sentences.en: Such a routine may seem modest, but its benefits accumulate through consistent practice.
sentences.zh: 这样的习惯或许看起来微不足道，但只要坚持练习，它的益处就会逐渐累积。
sentences.note: modest 此处指规模小、不起眼，而非谦虚。through consistent practice 表示实现积累的途径；翻译时显化为只要坚持练习。

sentences.en: Over time, the learner builds not only a larger vocabulary but also a more reliable method of thinking.
sentences.zh: 久而久之，学习者收获的不仅是更丰富的词汇，还包括一套更可靠的思考方法。
sentences.note: not only ... but also ... 连接两个并列宾语。Over time 指随着时间推移；build a method 按中文习惯处理为形成或收获一套方法。

sentences.en: The purpose of deep reading is not to finish every page quickly, but to leave each page with something worth remembering.
sentences.zh: 深度阅读的目的，并不是匆匆读完每一页，而是在读完每一页时，都带走一些值得记住的东西。
sentences.note: not ... but ... 连接两个表语不定式。worth remembering 修饰 something；leave each page with ... 是比喻表达，指阅读后有所收获。

articles.title: When cities make room for nature
articles.subtitle: 当城市为自然留出空间

sentences.en: A small patch of urban woodland can offer more than a pleasant view from an office window.
sentences.zh: 城市中一小片林地所带来的，可能远不只是办公室窗外一道宜人的风景。
sentences.note: more than 表示不仅仅；from an office window 指观看风景的视角。patch 表示小块土地，不是补丁。

sentences.en: Trees provide shade, absorb rainfall and create habitats for species that would otherwise struggle to survive in a city.
sentences.zh: 树木提供荫凉、吸收雨水，也为那些在城市里本来难以生存的物种创造栖息地。
sentences.note: provide、absorb 和 create 是三个并列谓语。that 引导定语从句修饰 species；otherwise 指如果没有这些树木。

sentences.en: Their value is particularly evident in neighborhoods where concrete surfaces dominate the landscape.
sentences.zh: 在那些放眼望去主要是混凝土路面的街区，树木的价值尤其明显。
sentences.note: where 引导定语从句修饰 neighborhoods。dominate the landscape 表示在景观中占据主导；concrete 此处为混凝土。

sentences.en: Yet creating green space is not simply a matter of planting as many trees as possible.
sentences.zh: 然而，打造绿地并不只是尽可能多地种树这么简单。
sentences.note: a matter of ... 表示关于某事的问题。as many ... as possible 表示尽可能多的……；Yet 引出对上段观点的补充与限制。

sentences.en: The location of a park determines who can reach it, while its design influences how people use it.
sentences.zh: 公园的位置决定哪些人能够方便地到达，而它的设计则影响人们如何使用这片空间。
sentences.note: who can reach it 和 how people use it 分别作 determines 与 influences 的宾语。while 在此表示对照，而非时间上的同时。

sentences.en: A large garden behind a locked gate contributes little to the daily lives of residents who have no access to it.
sentences.zh: 一座大花园如果被锁在门后，对那些无法进入的居民的日常生活也就帮助不大。
sentences.note: contribute little to 表示对……贡献很小。who have no access to it 修饰 residents；access 指进入或使用的机会。

sentences.en: By contrast, a modest public square with comfortable seating may become an important meeting place.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，一处规模不大却配有舒适座椅的公共广场，可能成为重要的聚会场所。
sentences.note: By contrast 表示与前句形成对照。with comfortable seating 是介词短语，修饰 public square；modest 描述规模不大。

sentences.en: Successful projects therefore begin by listening to the people who will share the space.
sentences.zh: 因此，成功的项目会先倾听未来共同使用这片空间的人们的意见。
sentences.note: begin by doing 表示从做某事开始。who will share the space 是定语从句；listening to 按语境译为倾听意见。

sentences.en: Older residents may need sheltered paths, whereas children may benefit from areas that encourage exploration.
sentences.zh: 年长居民可能需要有遮蔽的步道，而孩子们则可能从鼓励探索的活动区域中获益。
sentences.note: whereas 连接两个对照的分句。benefit from 表示从……获益；that encourage exploration 修饰 areas。

sentences.en: When these different needs are considered together, environmental improvement can also strengthen social connections.
sentences.zh: 当这些不同需求得到统筹考虑时，环境的改善也能增进人与人之间的联系。
sentences.note: are considered 是一般现在时的被动语态。together 在此表示统筹考虑，而不是所有人同时思考。

sentences.en: Maintaining a green space is a long-term commitment rather than a single construction task.
sentences.zh: 维护一片绿地需要长期投入，而不是完成一次建设任务就可以了。
sentences.note: Maintaining a green space 是动名词短语作主语。rather than 连接相对的两种认识；commitment 在此表示持续的投入与责任。

sentences.en: Without reliable funding and clear responsibilities, even an attractive project can gradually lose its appeal.
sentences.zh: 如果没有可靠的经费保障与明确的职责分工，即使一个原本很有吸引力的项目，也可能逐渐失去魅力。
sentences.note: Without 引出条件。even 表示强调；gradually lose its appeal 指随着缺少维护而逐步失去吸引力。

sentences.en: A sustainable city treats nature as part of its essential infrastructure and makes room for it in everyday decisions.
sentences.zh: 一座可持续发展的城市，会把自然视为必不可少的基础设施，并在日常决策中为它留出空间。
sentences.note: treat A as B 表示把 A 视为 B。treats 与 makes 是并列谓语；make room for 在此兼有空间规划与决策重视的含义。
